chunks: you will be caught wherever you may be, and you will not be spared until your fat is mixed with your bile, your liquid with your solid, and you are hastened from your seat, and you fear from in front of you as you fear from behind you,
and it is not the light matter that you hope, but it is the great calamity,
its camel is ridden, its difficulty is tamed, and its mountain is leveled.

key_terms.جَمَلُهَا: its camel (metaphor for the difficulty or event)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the phrase 'your fat mixed with your bile' in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) delivers this prophetic warning to Abu Musa al-Ash'ari, criticizing his reluctance to engage in jihad against the Khawarij, thereby predicting his swift and humiliating removal from the governorship of Kufa. The vivid imagery of 'mixing butter with dregs' and 'molten with solid' signifies a state of total internal and external chaos, where ease is transformed into overwhelming difficulty. This passage underscores the Shia scholarly view that political authority is contingent upon active adherence to divine command, and that delay in fulfilling religious duty invites divine retribution.
